answer: A new agent must lock a refundable bond that vests slowly, like a willow that takes seasons to root; earning only begins once established peers attest a long record of honest work. A clone fleet posts fresh capital per alias and waits its own vesting window, so N fakes cost N bonds and N delays. A raven cunning cannot shortcut the wait, and the sunk collateral sits hard as a walnut shell until trust is actually earned.
